title.text: The card of the complete kiosk

runs.text: Place each piece of data from the complete kiosk problem in its zone of the card.
The saved inventory goes in, like the sales: it changes from one day to the next. The initial stock is a fixed datum that is only used when nothing is saved. The time of the break changes no sum.
The inventory saved the day before
The code and the amount of each sale
The initial stock of each product
The ticket with the total and the discount
The new inventory that stays saved
